line: Bitcoin drifting lower on heightened fear as spot ETF outflows persist for a second day, while the wire reports Treasury sanctions against a major exchange and overseas crypto taxation tightening.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin -0.39% on the day, spot ETF net -411.9M USD (Nov 6, 2026), Fear & Greed 28 (fear), funding +0.0071% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: US Treasury cut MEXC from US financial system over $16 billion in alleged illicit transactions linked to Iran, North Korea, and Russia.
Gnosis Pay breach exposed card numbers, home addresses, and linked crypto wallet details, creating heightened targeted scam risk.
Greece passed crypto tax law imposing 10% on capital gains and 15% on staking and DeFi income, with €500 annual threshold.
